_comment: THREE PILLARS P5: the milestone's own end-to-end proof of the FIELD-SKILL LOOP. Loads the near_tactician fixture (warrior L1 at the inn, chess_with_olesm banked (the [Tactician] driver -- earned at Olesm's chessboard), [Basic Cleaning] innate) via the title 'Continue'. PHASE A proves the overworld hotbar itself: it renders at load (slots:1, the innate [Basic Cleaning]); a NUMBER KEY on the faced dirty_table fires the exact interact stream (P1 byte-parity: skill_used{basic_cleaning,dirty_table} + accomplishment cleaned_the_inn + the same toast); and a number key facing empty floor takes the field_ambient fallback. PHASE B proves the earned-class arc: one sleep resolves TWO gained_by gates at once -- the pre-banked chess_with_olesm grants [Tactician] (the class is earned at Olesm's chessboard, user ruling) and Phase A's fresh cleaned_the_inn:1 grants [Helper] (a genuine emergent co-grant: the loop earns Helper by doing the chore) -- so the hotbar RE-RENDERS from 1 field slot to THREE ([Basic Cleaning], [Helper]'s [Basic Cooking], [Tactician]'s [Appraise Foe], in catalog order). Pressing [Appraise Foe]'s slot (3) on Erin surfaces her exact observe string as a toast and reveals the skill in the journal (used_skills). No combat anywhere -- fixture rng_state governs, --seed is cosmetic; seed 9 for convention. GH#336: the Skills tab is category-primary and deduped now, so every cursor index this script pins was re-derived off the new `skill_row_ids` payload (row 5 = [Basic Cleaning], row 7 = [Appraise Foe]); `ui_journal_loadout_rendered` also carries `slottable` and both pinned rows are true.

steps._comment: a4 #216 slice 2 (touch drag-to-scroll), RELOCATED here from journal_history by issue #209: near_tactician's multi-class kit (Innate + Warrior L1 + Helper + Tactician) overflows the shrunk one-tab Skills body, so a touch/mouse drag UP pans it DOWN. A fresh tab switch resets scroll to 0; the drag moves it off zero. (journal_history_start no longer overflows ANY single tab post-split -- measured -- so the touch-scroll proof rides this bigger-kit fixture instead of journal_history.)

POSITIVE CONTROL for the pan/tap latch (v0.15 Task 2.1 fix round 1). The drag above must NOT toggle a skill -- that negative is pinned below, where `loadout: ["observe"]` is a SINGLE-element list any stray toggle breaks. This is the other half: a STATIONARY press still reaches meta_clicked and still toggles. GH#336 re-pin, twice over: (1) the categorized body is TALLER (a Classes strip plus four category headings), so the drag's own release point (0.25 of body height) now lands on a heading -- not a row, and headings are deliberately non-focusable -- and the tap is aimed explicitly at 0.52 (measured band ~0.47-0.57, re-derive by sweeping at_height_fraction if the Skills body ever changes height again), which lands on [Basic Cleaning], now row 5 of the Exploration - Active bucket rather than row 0 of Innate. (2) the OFF direction is driven by `click_journal_skill` on the SAME row instead of a second tap at the same point: a slottable toggle rebuilds the body follow-cursor, so the post-toggle scroll moves the row out from under a repeated geometric tap. One tap-driven toggle is all the latch needs to prove; the index-addressed unassign restores the empty-loadout baseline every pin below depends on.

GH#336 re-pin: the tap legs above left the cursor on [Basic Cleaning] (row 5); two more downs reach [Appraise Foe] at row 7, the last row of the Exploration - Active bucket. It was six downs from row 0 back when the tab was class-primary.
